content: Chromium aligns pointermove to rAF (since Chrome 60), so a 240Hz pen delivers ~60 dispatched events/s; use getCoalescedEvents() to recover sub-frame samples. pointerrawupdate is secure-context only, may itself be coalesced, is not more precise, and MDN warns handlers that cannot keep up make the app feel less responsive. Synthetic PointerEvents return empty coalesced lists. e.pressure is 0.5 for mouse-with-button, 0 for many touch devices, continuous 0-1 for pens; naive width=base*pressure produces half-width mouse strokes or invisible touch strokes.
